name: Kidron
overview: The Kidron Valley, also known as Cedron, is a significant geographical and spiritual landmark situated between Jerusalem and the Mount of Olives. Scripture highlights its sacred status, as Jeremiah 31:40 describes the valley as holy unto the LORD, never to be destroyed again. It is also the brook Jesus crossed on the night of His agony, as recorded in John 18:1, marking a pivotal moment in His passion. Additionally, Nehemiah 2:15 references the brook in the context of Jerusalem's defenses, emphasizing its practical and historical importance.
